name: Snow Blindness
problem_statement: A polar bear in a snowstorm. We lost the flag in the blizzard.

hints.text: Check the CSS file. Something is matching the background.
Can you read white text on a white background? Change the color properties.

name: The Z-Index Trap
problem_statement: Something massive is blocking your view. Dig under it.

hints.text: There is an invisible layer covering everything.
Look for properties related to depth or layers in the CSS.

name: Peekaboo
problem_statement: The flag is right there on the screen, but it's playing hide and seek.

hints.text: Check how the display property is set.

name: Ghost Protocol
problem_statement: The text is here, but it's totally transparent.

hints.text: Look for a property that controls transparency in CSS.

name: The Developer's Secret
problem_statement: Developers always leave notes for themselves. Sometimes they forget to delete them.

hints.text: Look at the raw HTML structure. Read it carefully.

/index.html.content: Nothing to see here! The page is working normally.

/styles.css.content: body { font-family: sans-serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 50px; }

name: Microscopic
problem_statement: You need a magnifying glass to read this one.

hints.text: The text exists, but the font size is way too small.

name: Off-Screen Excursion
problem_statement: The flag has left the building. Bring it back to the center.

hints.text: The element is pushed way out of the visible screen area using absolute positioning.

name: Console Confession
problem_statement: Not everything is meant for the main screen. Check the backend logs.

hints.text: Where do developers print debugging messages in a browser? Press F12.

/index.html.content: Check the logs. The UI is clean.

/script.js.content: console.log('The flag is hidden here: TERMINAL_77');

name: Hover Hack
problem_statement: The answer will only reveal itself when you point exactly at it.

hints.text: Check the pseudo-classes in CSS like :hover.

name: The Disabled Button
problem_statement: The system locked the button. You need administrative override to click it.

hints.text: Look at the button tag in the HTML. Why is it unclickable?

/script.js.content: document.getElementById('btn').addEventListener('click', () => alert('FLAG_UNLOCKED'));

name: Buried Treasure
problem_statement: The secret is buried in a hidden input field meant for the server.

hints.text: HTML forms sometimes hold invisible data. Check the input types.

name: Claustrophobia
problem_statement: The box is way too small to fit the entire message.

hints.text: The text is overflowing the box, but the CSS is hiding the overflow.

/index.html.content: Here is some text and eventually the flag is BOXED_IN_22

name: Fog Glasses
problem_statement: Everything is just a little too blurry to read.

hints.text: There is a CSS filter applied to the body.

name: Contrast Clash
problem_statement: You are staring right at it, but the colors are too similar.

hints.text: The text color and background color are almost exactly identical hex codes.

name: Pseudo-Hiding
problem_statement: The HTML is completely empty, yet the text is on the screen. How?

hints.text: CSS can inject content directly into the page. Look for '::before' or '::after'.

name: Flexbox Jumble
problem_statement: The letters are all mixed up. Put them back in order.

hints.text: The container uses Flexbox. Look at how the 'order' property rearranges HTML elements.

/index.html.content: T X F _ L I E

name: Rotated Reality
problem_statement: You might need to stand on your head for this one.

hints.text: The text container has been flipped and rotated using CSS transforms.

name: The Annoying Poha Plate
problem_statement: A giant plate of Poha is blocking your view and keeps following your cursor!

hints.text: The image is tracking your mouse via JavaScript.
Delete the image tag from the HTML or clear out the JS file completely.

name: Margin Mess
problem_statement: All the characters collapsed into a single black dot.

hints.text: The elements have wild negative margins pulling them into each other.

/index.html.content: UNCOLLAPSE

name: Speed Reader
problem_statement: The text is flying by way too fast to read. Slow it down.

hints.text: Check the CSS animation properties. The duration is set way too low.

name: LocalStorage Loot
problem_statement: We dropped a package in your browser's local warehouse.

hints.text: Check the Application/Storage tab in your browser's Developer Tools.

/script.js.content: localStorage.setItem('secret_flag', 'IDEA_HACK_99');

name: The Short Input
problem_statement: The system asks for a password, but the input box won't let you type enough characters.

hints.text: The HTML input element has a restriction (maxlength) on how many characters you can type.

name: Class Toggle Chaos
problem_statement: There is way too much noise. Filter out the fakes.

hints.text: Only spans with the class '.real' matter. Hide the rest using CSS display property.

/index.html.content: XRYEZAWLQIPTMY

/styles.css.content: body { font-size: 3rem; font-family: monospace; letter-spacing: 5px; }

name: The SVG Mask
problem_statement: Half of the text has been sliced off by a vector shape.

hints.text: Look for a CSS clip-path or SVG mask property applied to the text container.

/index.html.content: HALF_FLAG_44

name: Blend Mode Magic
problem_statement: The text is camouflaged perfectly into the background pattern.

hints.text: The text uses a CSS mix-blend-mode that makes it merge with the colors behind it.

name: The Puzzled Canvas
problem_statement: The artwork is completely dark. Bring some color to the shapes to see the hidden message.

hints.text: The shapes are drawn using the Canvas API in JavaScript.
All fill styles are set to black (#000000). Change the text fillStyle to a contrasting color.

name: Keypress Konami
problem_statement: Execute the secret sequence to unlock the vault.

hints.text: The JavaScript is listening for a specific combination of arrow keys.
Click the preview window and type Up, Up, Down, Left on your keyboard.

/index.html.content: Enter the sequence. Click here first to focus.

name: CSS Grid Labyrinth
problem_statement: The path is there, but the tiles aren't glowing. Light them up.

hints.text: A specific CSS class (.path) is assigned to certain grid cells, but it has no styling.

name: The Split Cookie
problem_statement: The key was snapped in half. One piece is in the jar, the other is in your current session.

hints.text: Check both the browser Cookies and Session Storage in your developer tools.

/script.js.content:
document.cookie = 'part1=HALF_; path=/';
sessionStorage.setItem('part2', 'BAKED_99');

name: Event Listener Trap
problem_statement: The system has locked down your controls. No right-clicking, no selecting, no inspecting. Break the lock.

hints.text: JavaScript is hijacking your mouse and keyboard events using preventDefault().
Delete the event listeners in the JS file and the preview will refresh.

/styles.css.content:
body { color: transparent; } /* Selection is required to read */
::selection { color: black; background: yellow; }

name: Flexbox Centering Crisis
problem_statement: The confidential code has drifted off into the digital void due to a flexbox layout catastrophe. Realign the container so the contents land dead center.

hints.text: Inspect the .vault-container in styles.css. The flex properties push elements to flex-end and apply a large translation offset.

name: Grid Column Overlap
problem_statement: A heavy metal shutter has locked into the exact same CSS grid coordinate as our security badge. Reconfigure the grid columns to reveal the badge.

hints.text: In styles.css, both .keycard and .shutter occupy grid-column 1 and grid-row 1. Relocate the shutter or hide it.

/index.html.content:
ACCESS BADGE
WEB_GRID_SPAN_32
BLOCKED

name: The Inverted Opacity
problem_statement: The mainframe rendered the decryption token, but zero opacity has masked it into total invisibility. Bring the token back to light.

hints.text: Locate .token-text in styles.css and adjust its opacity property from 0 to 1.

name: Collapsed Dimensions
problem_statement: The safe drawer holding the verification passcode has its height and width clamped to zero with hidden overflow. Restore its natural proportions.

hints.text: Check .safe-drawer in styles.css. Both width and height are 0px and overflow is hidden.

name: Attribute Sleuth
problem_statement: A security badge carries a confidential credential in its data attribute, but nothing is drawn in the element body. Use CSS pseudo-elements with attr() to project the secret onto the screen.

hints.text: In styles.css, add a ::before or ::after pseudo-element to .security-badge with content: attr(data-flag).

name: Visibility Hidden Trap
problem_statement: The dossier entry preserves its physical space on screen, but CSS visibility: hidden is suppressing its render tree. Toggle the property.

hints.text: In styles.css, change visibility: hidden to visibility: visible on .classified-line.

name: The Clipping Mask
problem_statement: A razor-sharp clip-path polygon with 0px bounds has cropped out the credential banner entirely. Expand the polygon or cancel the clipping.

hints.text: Set clip-path: none or clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%) on .cred-banner in styles.css.

name: Scale to Zero
problem_statement: The security console display text has been miniaturized to infinitesimal zero scale via CSS transforms. Enlarge it back to standard scale.

hints.text: Find .console-output in styles.css and change transform: scale(0) to transform: scale(1).

name: Color Inversion Disguise
problem_statement: The secret message was styled with transparent text against a transparent container. Assign a bold, vibrant foreground color to read it.

hints.text: Change color: transparent to a visible color like #38bdf8 or white in styles.css.

name: Flex Order Scramble
problem_statement: The fragments of the keycard string have been jumbled across flexbox children using irregular order values. Sequence them 1 through 4.

hints.text: Assign order: 1 to .seg-1, order: 2 to .seg-2, order: 3 to .seg-3, and order: 4 to .seg-4 in styles.css.

name: Click Hijack Interceptor
problem_statement: A malicious security handler is capturing click events on the authorization button and halting propagation before it reaches the voucher handler. Disarm the blocker.

hints.text: Remove e.stopImmediatePropagation() and e.preventDefault() in script.js so the authorized listener in auth.js can execute.

/index.html.content: VOUCHER CLAIM TERMINAL

name: Client-Side Regex Bypass
problem_statement: The registration gate enforces a strict 3-character lowercase regex that rejects genuine clearance codes. Adjust the validation logic in script.js to trigger the authorization event.

hints.text: Update script.js so window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('authorized')) fires when the form is submitted with code 'BYPASS'.

/index.html.content: GATE VERIFICATION

name: LocalStorage Tamper Vault
problem_statement: The gatekeeper script reads localStorage for the 'user_role' key. If it finds 'guest', access is forbidden. Tamper with localStorage in script.js to elevate role to 'admin'.

hints.text: Set localStorage.setItem('user_role', 'admin') and call checkAccess() in script.js.

/index.html.content:
ACCESS CONTROL

Checking privileges...

name: SessionStorage Fragment Assembly
problem_statement: The secure enclave verifies sessionStorage for an authorized debug override flag. Modify the session storage in script.js to unlock the payload.

hints.text: Set sessionStorage.setItem('debug_override', 'true') and execute evaluateSession() in script.js.

/index.html.content:
SESSION VAULT

Enclave locked

name: URL Hash Route Dispatcher
problem_statement: A client-side hash router monitors window.location.hash for navigation events. Direct the router to '#admin_portal' to expose the administrative view.

hints.text: Set window.location.hash = '#admin_portal' or trigger a hashchange event with that hash in script.js.

/script.js.content:
// Set the hash route to navigate to the administrative route
// window.location.hash = '#admin_portal';

name: Disabled Input Override
problem_statement: The PIN verification interface has disabled the input element and set maxlength to 2, blocking entry of the four-digit passcode '7701'. Strip the constraints and submit.

hints.text: In script.js, remove the disabled and readonly attributes from #pin-field, set its value to '7701', and click #submit-pin.

/index.html.content: SECURITY PIN GATE

/script.js.content: // Unlock #pin-field, assign value '7701', and trigger #submit-pin click

name: Custom Event Dispatcher
problem_statement: The kernel message bus listens for a CustomEvent named 'kernel:unlock' bearing authorization key 'ALPHA_OMEGA'. Dispatch the event to breach the kernel.

hints.text: Dispatch window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kernel:unlock', { detail: { authorizationKey: 'ALPHA_OMEGA' } })) in script.js.

/index.html.content:
KERNEL BUS

Listening for kernel signal...

/script.js.content: // Dispatch 'kernel:unlock' CustomEvent with detail: { authorizationKey: 'ALPHA_OMEGA' }

name: History State Navigator
problem_statement: The browser session manager monitors popstate history transitions. Transition history state to { level: 'master' } to trigger administrative elevation.

hints.text: Dispatch a PopStateEvent with state: { level: 'master' } or push state and invoke back() in script.js.

/index.html.content:
SESSION HISTORIAN

Standard User Session

/script.js.content:
// Transition popstate history state to level: 'master'
window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate', { state: { level: 'master' } }));

name: Timer Hijack Race
problem_statement: An auto-lock timer running on window.lockoutTimer disables the terminal button after 500ms. Abort the timeout using clearTimeout before clicking.

hints.text: Call clearTimeout(window.lockoutTimer) and then document.getElementById('unlock-btn').click() in script.js.

/index.html.content:
DEFENSE LOCKOUT

Timer armed

name: Cookie Attribute Tampering
problem_statement: The clearance gate verifies document.cookie for authorization credentials. Set cookie 'badge_tier=commander; path=/' and invoke verifyCookie() to pass.

hints.text: In script.js, assign document.cookie = 'badge_tier=commander; path=/'; and call verifyCookie().

/index.html.content:
CLEARANCE GATE

Guest Tier

name: JWT None Algorithm Bypass
problem_statement: The client token parser accepts tokens signed with algorithm 'none'. Craft an unsigned JWT with header {'alg':'none'} and payload role 'root' to authenticate.

hints.text: Base64 encode header JSON {'alg':'none','typ':'JWT'} and payload {'user':'admin','role':'root'}, join with a dot, add a trailing dot, and pass to verifyJWT(token).

/index.html.content:
TOKEN VERIFIER

Awaiting Valid Token

name: Prototype Pollution Infiltration
problem_statement: The configuration merge engine processes arbitrary JSON keys into prototype chains without filtering __proto__. Inject isAdmin into Object.prototype to escalate to root.

hints.text: Invoke mergeConfig(JSON.parse('{"__proto__": {"isAdmin": True}}')) and then call authenticateUser() in script.js.

/index.html.content:
CONFIG ENGINE

Standard Access Mode

name: Iframe PostMessage Eavesdrop
problem_statement: An isolated sub-frame periodically broadcasts classified telemetry via window.parent.postMessage with wildcard target origin. Set up a window message listener to capture the broadcast.

hints.text: Listen to window.addEventListener('message', (e) => { ... }) and display e.data.secret inside #inbox.

/index.html.content:
CROSS-ORIGIN BUS

Listening for iframe message...

name: WebSocket Handshake Emulation
problem_statement: A simulated real-time socket transport endpoint requires a strict initial handshake packet with protocol 'wss' and subprotocol 'idealab-v2'. Dispatch the handshake to open the channel.

hints.text: Send { protocol: 'wss', subprotocol: 'idealab-v2', token: 'SESSION_INIT' } using window.mockSocket.send() in script.js.

/index.html.content:
WEBSOCKET GATEWAY

Socket Standby

name: CORS Preflight Simulation
problem_statement: An internal API gateway simulates CORS origin validation. Submit an authorized simulated request with Origin 'https://admin.idealab.internal' to retrieve the secret.

hints.text: Call mockFetch('/api/vault', { headers: { 'Origin': 'https://admin.idealab.internal', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } }) in script.js.

/index.html.content:
CORS SIMULATOR

Awaiting authorized origin request

name: DOM Clobbering Escalation
problem_statement: The global script relies on window.systemConfig.apiUrl without prior declaration. Inject named DOM elements into index.html to clobber window.systemConfig with value 'trusted'.

hints.text: Inject <form id='systemConfig'><input name='apiUrl' value='trusted'></form> into the DOM or configure script.js to set it before checkConfig() runs.

/index.html.content:
GLOBAL CONFIG GUARD

Config pending...

name: Service Worker Cache Tamper
problem_statement: The offline service worker controller looks up the cache entry at '/offline/key'. Pre-populate the cache mock with 'OFFLINE_AUTHORIZED' to bypass the network barrier.

hints.text: Invoke window.mockCaches.put('/offline/key', 'OFFLINE_AUTHORIZED') and execute checkCache() in script.js.

/index.html.content:
OFFLINE CACHE GATEWAY

Cache miss: Offline key not found

name: MutationObserver Leak Intercept
problem_statement: An ephemeral injection routine inserts an element containing classified data and removes it within 10ms. Deploy a MutationObserver on document.body to intercept the fleeting node.

hints.text: Instantiate a MutationObserver observing document.body with childList: True, and capture the text of any node with id 'ephemeral-secret'.

/index.html.content:
EPHEMERAL VAULT

Vault standby...

name: Web Worker Channel Hijack
problem_statement: The background computing worker instance expects a command 'DISPATCH_KEY' with clearance level 9. Post the command message to the worker to receive the flag.

hints.text: Execute window.mockWorker.postMessage({ cmd: 'DISPATCH_KEY', clearance: 9 }) in script.js.

/index.html.content:
WORKER PIPELINE

Worker standby

name: CSS Keyframe Exfiltration
problem_statement: A CSS keyframe animation named 'pulse' triggers animation events carrying secret data in the beacon target. Listen for the 'animationstart' event to exfiltrate the secret.

hints.text: Add an event listener for 'animationstart' and read e.target.getAttribute('data-secret') when e.animationName is 'pulse'.

/index.html.content:
KEYFRAME RADAR

Waiting for radar sweep...
